name: Sakata INX Corporation
summary: Sakata INX Corporation manufactures and sells various printing inks and auxiliary agents in Japan, Asia, the America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers gravure inks, flexographic inks, powder color toners, offset inks, industrial inject inks, functional coating materials, newspaper inks, and pigment dispersion for color fillers; and metal inks for equipment, machines, and consumables. It is also involved in the sale of printing plate-making and related equipment, and electronic apparatus and information-related equipment; manufacture and sale of various printing inks and auxiliary agents, and manufacture and sale of digital and specialty products.
